# Daily Report — 2026-07-30

## Task Completed
Added `trigger_flow` and `list_flow_executions` tools to `flow_tools.py`.

- **trigger_flow**: POSTs to `/api/now/v2/flow_api/flows/{sys_id}/executions` to run a
  Flow Designer flow on demand. Accepts a `flow_id` (sys_id or exact name) and an optional
  `inputs` dict of flow input variables. Returns `execution_id`, `status`, and a confirmation
  message. Resolves flow name to sys_id via `_resolve_flow_sys_id` before calling the v2 API.

- **list_flow_executions**: GETs `sys_flow_context` (the flow execution history table).
  Supports filtering by `flow_id` (name/sys_id resolver), `state` (running/complete/error/
  cancelled/waiting), `started_after`, and `started_before`. Full pagination with `has_more`
  / `next_offset`. Reference fields (`flow`, `run_as`) normalised to display values.

Both tools registered in `__init__.py`, `tool_utils.py`, and `config/tool_packages.yaml`
(platform_developer + full packages).
